scenario: Prioritization produces unequal recall across protected groups
control: Measure group and intersectional recall and apply the configured threshold
evidence: LAB12 subgroup metrics and audit report

scenario: Model output is treated as an automatic decision
affected: People represented by the synthetic cases
control: Require documented human review before any action
evidence: Sampled review records and override log

scenario: Use expands from synthetic education to real territorial profiling
affected: People or communities in real territories
control: Restrict use to synthetic data and suspend the system if real profiling is detected
evidence: Access review and documented incident log

scenario: False positives consume review capacity without sufficient justification
control: Review false positives and compare against the non-predictive baseline

scenario: Operators rely on scores without reviewing supporting evidence
control: Train operators and require a documented reason for decisions and overrides
evidence: Training record and completed review forms

scenario: Direct identifiers are introduced into the dataset
affected: People if real data are improperly introduced
control: Reject real personal data and verify the documented data contract
evidence: Dataset inspection and privacy test results

scenario: Model or dataset changes make results irreproducible
control: Version data transformations configuration and evaluation outputs

scenario: An incident is not escalated or contained in time
affected: People represented by cases and the institution
control: Define escalation authority evidence preservation and a rollback procedure
